text.p: Westminster Healthcare Plc has seen occupancy rates maintained into the current financial year, chairman John Lockart told the annual meeting.
"I am pleased to say...occupancy rates have been maintained into the current financial year," Lockhart said.
He said the rate was close to 90 percent in mature homes at the end of the year and the trend for improvement has continued.
Lockhart said the company was "in a strong position to continue our programme of selective expansion."
He said the company was disappointed that its attempt to buy Goldsborough Healthcare had failed.
Lockhart added, however, that "the new financial year has got off to a good start and the board views the future with confidence."
